about_the_game:
Putt Down is a first person mini-golf horror. The game takes place in the same universe as Gone Golfing, but instead of a putter you have a shotgun and it will be your go to problem solver. It can be used as putter or as a regular firearm. But this shotgun is a fragile tool, the more you use it the less reliable it will get. You will need to score points and collect coins so you can repair you gun to keep it in good condition, because if you don't it will start to misfire when you least want it to.

You play as a highly neurotic man with nicotine addiction named John Golfing. You have made some very poor life choices that has led you to rake up massive gambling debts and now the people you owe money are out to collect. But before you could flee the country you are kidnapped by a mysterious man with a bizarre offer that you cannot refuse.

Gameplay consist of trying to survive while playing mini-golf with a shotgun. You will have to manage weapon degradation and panic levels with different items. All golf obstacles are random and will also face random events tied to each level.

Features

  • Physics Based Golfing

  • Golfing with a shotgun

  • Survival Horror with panic system

  • Managing equipment status and weapon degradation.

  • Randomized golf courses and events

  • Based on gone golfing
